name: normal_routine_payment
label_rationale: Routine payment without any risk indicators.

name: first_time_payee_only
label_rationale: A new payee alone is not sufficient to classify a payment as risky.

name: unusual_hour_only
label_rationale: An unusual payment hour alone is a weak indicator.

name: large_amount_only
label_rationale: A relatively large amount alone does not establish fraud.

name: single_retry_only
label_rationale: One payment retry can occur during normal use.

name: recent_sim_change_only
label_rationale: A recent SIM or device change warrants additional caution in this synthetic dataset.

name: remote_access_only
label_rationale: Active remote access can indicate that another person is controlling the device.

name: screen_sharing_only
label_rationale: Screen sharing can expose sensitive payment information.

name: phone_call_only
label_rationale: An active phone call can be a warning sign of social engineering.

name: collect_request_only
label_rationale: A collect request can be abused to trick users into authorising a payment.

name: mule_payee_only
label_rationale: A payee on a simulated mule-account list is a strong risk indicator.

name: high_vpa_similarity_only
label_rationale: A high payee-address lookalike score can indicate impersonation.

name: call_and_new_payee
label_rationale: An active call combined with a first-time payee is a stronger warning pattern.

name: remote_access_and_new_payee
label_rationale: Remote access combined with a new payee is a high-risk combination.

name: new_payee_and_high_vpa_similarity
label_rationale: A new payee with a highly similar payment address can indicate impersonation.

name: mule_payee_and_phone_call
label_rationale: A flagged payee combined with an active call represents a strong risk pattern.

name: screen_sharing_and_collect_request
label_rationale: Screen sharing alongside a collect request can expose the user to payment manipulation.

name: multiple_behavior_signals_same_family
label_rationale: Several simultaneous behavioural warnings warrant caution even though they belong to one signal family.

name: several_signals_from_behaviour_family
label_rationale: An unusual hour and large amount can occur together in a legitimate transaction.

name: remote_access_and_screen_sharing_only
label_rationale: This scenario preserves the existing synthetic assumption that device signals alone can occur in a benign context.

name: multiple_signals_with_benign_context
label_rationale: This is intended as a benign-context example, but the current signals do not explicitly encode that context.

name: odd_hour_and_repeated_retries
label_rationale: An unusual hour combined with repeated retries can indicate a suspicious payment attempt.

name: device_change_and_first_time_payee
label_rationale: A recent device or SIM change combined with a new payee warrants additional caution.

name: remote_access_with_mule_payee
label_rationale: Remote access combined with a flagged payee is a strong warning pattern.

name: collect_request_with_repeated_retries
label_rationale: A collect request accompanied by repeated retries deserves additional scrutiny.
